title: Zero-TAF Decision-Record Store Export
description: The export envelope of a hash-chained decision-record store: the records, and the head (count, last hash, RFC 6962-style batch root). The head lets a verifier check the whole export without trusting the exporter (ZT-NM-EVD-3). Field semantics: docs/evidence-store-specification-scope.md.

last_record_hash.description: The last record's hash, or zt-genesis for an empty store.

batch_root.description: RFC 6962-style Merkle tree head over the record digests.
